removeProtectedRange(id: string): ApplyTransactionResult; getPivots(sheet?: SheetId): PivotDefinition[]; setPivot(pivot: PivotDefinition, sheet?: SheetId): ApplyTransactionResult; removePivot(id: string, sheet?: SheetId): ApplyTransactionResult; getPivotFields(sheet: SheetId, id: string): PivotSourceField[]; getPivotResult(sheet: SheetId, id: string): PivotResultView | null; getCharts(sheet?: SheetId): readonly ChartDefinition[]; setChart(chart: ChartDefinition, sheet?: SheetId): ApplyTransactionResult; removeChart(id: string, sheet?: SheetId): ApplyTransactionResult; selectChart(id: string | null, sheet?: SheetId): void; openPanel(panel: GridPanel | null): void; setProtectionResolver(resolver: ProtectionResolver | undefined, mode?: MutationPolicyMode): void; setNote(addr: CellAddress, text: string | null): ApplyTransactionResult; getNote(addr: CellAddress): string | null; setOverscan(overscan?: number): void; setMinColumns(minColumns?: number): void; highlightCells(ranges: readonly HighlightRange[] | null, color?: string): void; setPresenceOverlays(overlays: readonly PresenceOverlay[] | null): void; styleRange(range: Range, style: Partial<CellStyle> | null): void; beginEdit(row: number, col: number, initial?: string, selectAll?: boolean): void; dataEdge(row: number, col: number, dRow: number, dCol: number): number | null; setRowHeight(row: number, height: number): void; setColumnWidth(col: number, width: number): void; autoFitRows(range?: Range): void; autoFitColumns(cols?: readonly number[]): void; setFrozen(rows: number, cols?: number): void; setZoom(zoom: number): void; getZoom(): number; rendererKind(): "canvas" | "worker"; on<E extends keyof GridEvents>(evt: E, fn: (e: GridEvents[E]) => void): () => void; refresh(): void; destroy(): void; }

Imperative grid handle for document commands, events, rendering, and teardown.
@example
```ts
import type { Grid } from "@sheetwrite/core";

function updateTotal(grid: Grid) {
 const sheet = grid.getActiveSheet();
 const result = grid.applyTransaction({
 patches: [{ op: "set", addr: { sheet, row: 0, col: 0 }, value: { kind: "literal", value: 42 } }],
 });
 if (result.status === "applied") grid.scrollToCell({ sheet, row: 0, col: 0 });
 return grid.aggregate(0, "sum");
}
```
@see
createGrid
@see
Grid.applyTransaction

Members:
- `actions` — Imperative action surface for binding custom toolbars/menus.
- `activateHyperlink` — Validate and emit a host-owned activation event. External targets are never
opened by Sheetwrite; internal navigation occurs only under the explicit policy.
- `addSheet` — Add a sheet with a stable ID and return its actionable transaction outcome.
- `aggregate` — Column aggregate over the active sheet's data.
@example
```ts
import type { Grid } from "@sheetwrite/core";

function total(grid: Grid) {
 return grid.aggregate(1, "sum");
}
```
@see
SheetwriteStore.aggregate
- `applyRemoteOperations` — Apply host-supplied operations without undo history or outgoing dirty state.
The resulting change event has `source: "remote"`.
- `applyTransaction` — Apply arbitrary patches as one undoable Grid commit. No-op when read-only.
Use `Store.applyTransaction` only for low-level writes that intentionally
bypass Grid history and policy.
@example
```ts
import type { Grid } from "@sheetwrite/core";

function setFirstCell(grid: Grid) {
 return grid.applyTransaction({ patches: [
 { op: "set", addr: { sheet: grid.getActiveSheet(), row: 0, col: 0 },
 value: { kind: "literal", value: 42 } },
 ] });
}
```
@see
Transaction
- `autoFitColumns` — Explicitly resize columns from a bulk worksheet read.
- `autoFitRows` — Explicitly resize rows to fit wrapped content; never runs during paint.
- `beginEdit` — Open the cell editor at a view cell, optionally seeding text / selecting all.
- `clearSearch` — Clear the current search and its highlights.
- `clearView` — Clear any active sort/filter view.
- `dataEdge` — Ctrl+Arrow-style jump target: the data-run edge from (row, col) on the
moved axis (row for vertical moves, col for horizontal), or null when the
store is not columnar. Under an active sort/filter view, `row` is a view
position and vertical moves return view positions. For hosts building
their own keymaps (`config.keyboard`).
- `distinctValues` — Distinct resolved values of a column in first-seen order. Defaults to
1,000 values for bounded filter menus; pass 0 to request an uncapped scan.
- `exportCsv` — Download the active sheet as CSV.
@example
```ts
import type { Grid } from "@sheetwrite/core";

function downloadCsv(grid: Grid) {
 grid.exportCsv("sales.csv");
}
```
- `exportSnapshot` — Deterministically export the complete authoritative workbook document.
- `exportXlsx` — Download the active sheet through the registered XLSX backend.
@example
```ts
import type { Grid } from "@sheetwrite/core";
import { registerXlsxBackends } from "@sheetwrite/xlsx";

async function downloadXlsx(grid: Grid) {
 await registerXlsxBackends();
 await grid.exportXlsx("sales.xlsx");
}
```
@see
toXlsxWorkbook
- `filterBy` — Filter the displayed rows to those whose column text contains `needle`.
@example
```ts
import type { Grid } from "@sheetwrite/core";

function showOpenRows(grid: Grid) {
 grid.filterBy(0, "Open");
}
```
@see
Grid.clearView
- `findNext` — Move the active match to the next match and scroll it into view.
- `findPrev` — Move the active match to the previous match and scroll it into view.
- `getActiveSheet` — Id of the currently visible sheet.
- `getCellAtPoint` — Resolve browser viewport coordinates to an active-sheet cell for host-owned
menus and interactions. Returns null outside the cell body.
- `getCellInput` — Editable snapshot of the cell at a view position on the active sheet, or
null when out of bounds. See {@link CellInputSnapshot}.
- `getCharts` — Clones of the chart definitions on `sheet` (default: the active sheet).
- `getColumnFilters` — Active column filters on the active sheet, keyed by column index.
- `getCommandState` — Query undo/redo availability and formatting active/mixed/disabled state.
- `getEffectiveTheme` — The effective (post-zoom) theme the renderer is currently painting with.
- `getFocusCellStyle` — Effective style of the focus cell: its own style over its column's
`cellStyle`. Empty when nothing is selected.
- `getPivotFields` — Source fields for the field list; empty on the default engine.
- `getPivotResult` — Plain-JSON output of one pivot. The default engine reports the saved
output (`saved`), or `unavailable` without one. Null when `sheet` holds
no pivot with `id`.
- `getPivots` — Clones of the pivot definitions on `sheet`, or on every sheet; no engine is needed.
- `getRuntimeResourceSnapshot` — Versioned coarse runtime ownership snapshot, including datasource state.
- `getShortcutLabel` — Platform-aware label for a bound action, or an empty string when disabled.
- `getTheme` — Resolved base theme, before zoom scaling. The returned object is a copy.
- `groupRows` — Define a collapsible row group over a data-row range (end-inclusive).
- `hiddenColumns` — Currently hidden columns on the active sheet.
- `hiddenRows` — Currently hidden data rows on the active sheet.
- `hideColumns` — Hide columns through one bulk-safe metadata transaction.
- `hideRows` — Hide the given data rows (composes with filters/sort).
- `highlightCells` — Draw temporary highlights outside document history. Pass `null` to clear all
highlights: `grid.highlightCells(null)`. Per-range `color` wins over the call color.
Undo does not clear highlights; use `styleRange` for persistent cell fills.
- `openPanel` — Show `panel` on the grid's right edge and shrink the cells to make room;
`null` closes the open panel. One panel shows at a time: opening a panel
closes the previous one. Escape and the close button close it and return
focus to the grid.
- `redo` — Redo the last undone cell edit.
- `removeChart` — Remove a chart from `sheet` (default: the first sheet that holds it) as one undo entry.
- `removePivot` — Remove a pivot from `sheet` (default: the sheet that holds it) as one undo entry.
- `removeSheet` — Remove a sheet while preserving at least one visible worksheet.
- `rendererKind` — Which renderer is actually active: `"worker"` when the OffscreenCanvas
worker constructed successfully, `"canvas"` otherwise (including after a
`renderer-fallback`).
- `replaceAll` — Replace every current match in a single undoable transaction (one
`undo()` restores them all), then re-scan. Formula/ref cells are skipped
and not counted. No-op when read-only.
- `replaceCurrent` — Replace the active match with `replacement`, then advance to the next match
(re-scanning against the new data). Only literal text/number cells are
eligible; formula and ref cells are skipped (formula source is never
rewritten). Honors the active {@link SearchOptions} (matchCase; `wholeCell`
swaps the entire cell). The write flows through the grid's commit path as
one undoable step. No-op when read-only or when there is no active match.
- `replaceTheme` — Option-level replacement: re-run construction-time resolution
(`DEFAULT_THEME < CSS custom properties < theme`) with the new partial.
`undefined` restores the CSS-variable/default resolution. Adapters call
this for their declarative `theme` prop; imperative patching stays on
{@link setTheme}.
- `rowGroups` — Row groups on the active sheet.
- `search` — Find cells matching `query`; highlights matches, emits `search`, returns the result.
- `selectChart` — Select the chart object `id` on `sheet` (default: the active sheet), or
deselect with `null`. Selecting a chart on another sheet activates that
sheet first. Emits `chart-select`.
- `setChart` — Insert or replace the chart with `chart.id` as one undo entry. `sheet`
defaults to the active sheet; chart IDs are unique only within a sheet.
- `setColumnFilter` — Set or clear (null) one column's filter. All column filters AND together
and compose with the active sort and hidden rows.
- `setColumnWidth` — Set one column's width via an undoable `setColumn` patch.
- `setConfig` — Reconfigure built-in chrome and keyboard handling without replacing the
Grid or clearing selection/history. Construction-bound GridOptions are not
accepted here.
- `setFrozen` — Pin the first `rows` view rows and `cols` columns; they stay visible while
the body scrolls (0 = unfreeze that axis). Persisted on the active sheet.
- `setGroupCollapsed` — Collapse/expand a row group; collapsing hides its rows.
- `setMinColumns` — Live-update the minimum rendered column count. Increasing the minimum
silently extends presentation padding; `undefined` restores the default.
- `setOverscan` — Live-update the render window overscan (row/column positions painted past
each edge); `undefined` restores the default of 6.
- `setPivot` — Insert or replace a pivot as one undo entry. `sheet` defaults to the sheet
that holds the pivot's ID, then to the active sheet. The pivot's
`savedOutput` is removed, because it does not match a changed definition.
- `setPresenceOverlays` — Replace ephemeral remote-presence overlays; null clears every collaborator.
- `setReadOnly` — Update editability without replacing the Grid or clearing session state.
- `setRowHeight` — Set one row's persistent display height through document history.
- `setSheetVisibility` — Set host-visible worksheet state; stock UI never offers `veryHidden`.
- `setSort` — Persisted multi-key sort of the active sheet.
- `setTheme` — Imperative patch: merge `theme` into the accumulated base theme.
- `setZoom` — Content zoom factor (0.5–2): scales row/column geometry and fonts.
- `showColumns` — Show columns through one bulk-safe metadata transaction.
- `showRows` — Show the given data rows again, or every hidden row when omitted.
- `sortBy` — Sort the displayed rows by a column (does not mutate stored data).
@example
```ts
import type { Grid } from "@sheetwrite/core";

function showLargestFirst(grid: Grid) {
 grid.sortBy(1, false);
}
```
@see
Grid.clearView
- `sortByMulti` — Multi-key sort of the displayed rows (first key primary; stable).
- `styleRange` — Merge `style` into every cell of `range` (null clears cell styles) as one
undoable transaction. Styles land in the store and paint in the canvas —
unlike {@link highlightCells}, which draws a translucent overlay above it.
- `summarizeSelection` — Totals for the current selection, for a status bar. Large selections are
read in chunks between frames, so the page stays responsive; abort
`signal` to stop early, which rejects with the signal's reason. Resolves
null when nothing is selected.
- `undo` — Undo the last recorded cell edit. If the restored data is above the
transaction resource limits, nothing changes: the Grid emits
`mutation-rejected` and removes that entry, so older edits stay undoable.
@example
```ts
import type { Grid } from "@sheetwrite/core";

function undoAndRestore(grid: Grid) {
 grid.undo();
 grid.redo();
}
```
@see
Grid.redo
- `ungroupRows` — Remove a row group (rows become visible if the group was collapsed).

##### `GridReadyEvent` — interface

```ts
export interface GridReadyEvent { grid: Grid; generation: number; reason: GridReadyReason; }
```

Grid handle, generation, and reason published after adapter initialization.

Members:
- `generation` — One-based adapter generation, incremented whenever a Grid is replaced.
- `grid` — Live handle just published by the adapter; replaced on the next reset generation.
- `reason` — Whether readiness followed first initialization, an input reset, or a renderer reset.

##### `RowBridge` — class

```ts
class RowBridge { constructor<Id extends RowBridgeId = RowBridgeId, Row extends Record<string, CellScalar> = Record<string, CellScalar>>(options: RowBridgeOptions<Row, Id>); columnKeys: (sheet?: SheetId) => readonly string[]; project: (event: ChangeEvent, requestedOperations?: readonly DocumentOp[], transactionId?: string) => RowBridgeProjection<Id>; reconcile: (input: RowBridgeReconciliationInput<Id>) => RowBridgeProjection<Id>; rowIds: (sheet?: SheetId) => readonly (Id | null)[] }
```

Projects canonical document transactions into host-owned row changes.

The bridge only owns compact data-space identity arrays. It never writes to
`defaultRows`, never renders, and never creates a second document store.

Members:
- `columnKeys` — Current semantic column keys in canonical column order.
- `project` — Project an applied Grid change as an accepted, transformed, or remote result.
- `reconcile` — Reconcile a canonical transaction response without synchronizing host rows implicitly.
- `rowIds` — Current data-space row identities; visual sort and filters do not affect this order.

##### `RowBridgeDelta` — type

```ts
export type RowBridgeDelta<Id extends RowBridgeId = RowBridgeId> = RowBridgeCellDelta<Id> | RowBridgeRangeDelta<Id> | RowBridgeClearDelta<Id> | RowBridgePasteDelta<Id> | RowBridgeFillDelta<Id> | RowBridgeRowStructureDelta<Id> | RowBridgeMetadataDelta<Id> | RowBridgeHostActionDelta<Id> | RowBridgeUnprojectableDelta<Id>;
```

Every possible projection produced by a row bridge.

##### `RowBridgeHandler` — type

```ts
export type RowBridgeHandler<Id extends RowBridgeId = RowBridgeId> = (projection: RowBridgeProjection<Id>) => void;
```

Callback accepted by imperative and framework adapters.

##### `RowBridgeId` — type

```ts
export type RowBridgeId = string | number;
```

A stable host identity for one data-space row.

##### `RowBridgeProjection` — interface

```ts
export interface RowBridgeProjection<Id extends RowBridgeId = RowBridgeId> { readonly status: RowBridgeReconciliationStatus; readonly transaction: RowBridgeTransaction; readonly deltas: readonly RowBridgeDelta<Id>[]; }
```

Result of projection or reconciliation.

```ts
import { createApp, h } from "vue";
import { Sheetwrite } from "@sheetwrite/vue";

const app = createApp({ render: () => h(Sheetwrite, {
 columns: [{ key: "amount", title: "Amount", type: "number" }],
```

```ts
import { createApp, h } from "vue";
import { SheetwriteGrid } from "@sheetwrite/vue";

function mountWorkbook(host: HTMLElement, workbook: Workbook) {
 const app = createApp({ render: () => h(SheetwriteGrid, { workbook, height: 400 }) });
 app.mount(host);
 return () => app.unmount();
}
```

##### `SheetwriteGridEmits` — interface

```ts
export interface SheetwriteGridEmits<Id extends RowBridgeId = RowBridgeId> { "row-delta": Parameters<RowBridgeHandler<Id>>[0]; "grid-change": ChangeEvent; "selection-change": Selection | null; "viewport-change": GridEvents["scroll"]; "edit-begin": GridEvents["edit-begin"]; "edit-commit": GridEvents["edit-commit"]; search: GridEvents["search"]; "command-state-change": GridEvents["command-state-change"]; "active-sheet-change": GridEvents["active-sheet"]; "mutation-rejected": GridEvents["mutation-rejected"]; "renderer-fallback": GridEvents["renderer-fallback"]; "datasource-error": GridEvents["datasource-error"]; "export-error": GridEvents["export-error"]; ready: GridReadyEvent; "initialization-error": SheetwriteError; }
```

Event payloads emitted by the Vue components, keyed by template event name.

Members:
- `active-sheet-change` — The visible sheet changed.
- `command-state-change` — Command availability or formatting activity changed.
- `datasource-error` — A datasource request failed.
- `edit-begin` — Cell editing began.
- `edit-commit` — An edit committed its parsed cell value.
- `export-error` — A built-in XLSX export action failed.
- `grid-change` — Committed Grid change, including its applied transaction.
- `initialization-error` — WASM initialization failed while the component stayed mounted.
- `mutation-rejected` — A Grid mutation was rejected.
- `ready` — The adapter published a ready Grid generation.
- `renderer-fallback` — Worker rendering fell back to the main-thread canvas renderer.
- `row-delta` — Projected host-row changes.
- `search` — Refreshed search matches and active-match index.
- `selection-change` — Current selection, or `null` after it is cleared.
- `viewport-change` — Visible row bounds and vertical scroll offset after scrolling.

```ts
export interface SheetwriteGridExpose { grid: Grid | null; }
```

Imperative Grid handle exposed by the Vue advanced component.

Members:
- `grid` — Live Grid after readiness, or `null` before initialization and during teardown.

##### `SheetwriteGridProps` — interface

```ts
export interface SheetwriteGridProps<Id extends RowBridgeId = RowBridgeId> { workbook: Workbook; data?: ColumnarData; datasource?: DataSource; datasourceStorage?: DataSourceStorageOptions; rowBridge?: RowBridge<Id>; renderer?: GridOptions["renderer"]; workerUrl?: GridOptions["workerUrl"]; presentation?: GridOptions["presentation"]; theme?: Partial<Theme>; readOnly?: boolean; protectionResolver?: GridOptions["protectionResolver"]; mutationPolicy?: GridOptions["mutationPolicy"]; transactionResourceLimits?: GridOptions["transactionResourceLimits"]; hyperlinkActivation?: GridOptions["hyperlinkActivation"]; renderers?: Record<string, CellRenderer>; editors?: GridOptions["editors"]; overscan?: number; minColumns?: number; config?: GridOptions["config"]; wasmSource?: SheetwriteInitializationProps["wasmSource"]; height?: number | string; fill?: boolean; }
```

Advanced Vue adapter props for workbook data or datasource ownership.

Members:
- `config` — Built-in toolbar, menu, keyboard, find, and tab controls.
- `data` — Eager column-major values for the active sheet.
- `datasource` — Lazy row provider requested for visible windows.
- `datasourceStorage` — Allocation and cache policy for datasource storage.
- `editors` — Named custom editors registered when the Grid is created.
- `fill` — Fills the parent's available width and height.
- `height` — Host height in CSS pixels for numbers or any CSS length string.
- `hyperlinkActivation` — Controls link activation: emit an event, also navigate internally, or disable it.
- `minColumns` — Minimum rendered column count, including empty padding columns.
- `mutationPolicy` — Atomic or partial handling for denied local operations.
- `overscan` — Extra rows painted above and below the viewport.
- `presentation` — Positional spreadsheet or semantic data-grid headers.
- `protectionResolver` — Host-owned client permission check for protected ranges.
- `readOnly` — Disables mutation while preserving navigation and selection.
- `renderer` — Paint backend; defaults to main-thread canvas.
- `renderers` — Named custom renderers registered when the Grid is created.
- `rowBridge` — Optional projection from canonical data-space operations to host row IDs.
- `theme` — Live overrides merged into the resolved Grid theme.
- `transactionResourceLimits` — Overrides inclusive operation-count and encoded-byte ceilings for every atomic mutation.
- `wasmSource` — Explicit source passed to process-wide WASM initialization.
- `workbook` — Live workbook schema adopted by the Grid.
- `workerUrl` — Browser-fetchable worker module URL.

Simple Vue adapter props for columns and default row objects.

- `datasourceStorage` — Allocation and cache policy for datasource storage.
- `defaultRows` — Rows converted to initial columnar data; missing keys become `null`.
- `editors` — Named custom editors registered when the Grid is created.
- `fill` — Fills the parent's available width and height.
- `getRowId` — Opt-in stable identity for each host row.

##### `SimpleColumn` — interface

```ts
export interface SimpleColumn<Row extends Record<string, CellScalar>> { key: keyof Row & string; title: string; width?: number; type?: CellFormat; numberFormat?: string; headerStyle?: CellStyle; editor?: string; cellStyle?: CellStyle; visible?: boolean; }
```

Column definition accepted by the adapters’ simple row-object API.

Members:
- `cellStyle` — Base style merged beneath cell-specific styles.
- `editor` — Name of a custom editor registered through `GridOptions.editors`.
- `headerStyle` — Style applied to the painted column header.
- `key` — Non-empty row-object key, unique within the column list.
- `numberFormat` — Excel number-format code used for number, date, or currency display.
- `title` — Semantic title painted in data-grid mode and written by table exports.
- `type` — Input and formatting type; defaults to `text`.
- `visible` — Set to `false` to exclude the column from the live view and table exports.
- `width` — Unzoomed width in CSS pixels; defaults to 120.

##### `CellOut` — class

```ts
class CellOut { free: () => void; kind: number; num: number; string: string | undefined; style: number }
```

Result of a single-cell read.

##### `CellSnapshot` — class

```ts
class CellSnapshot { free: () => void; kinds: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>; numbers: Float64Array<ArrayBufferLike>; strings: string[]; styles: Uint32Array<ArrayBufferLike>; textIndex: Int32Array<ArrayBufferLike> }
```

Resolved values of a sparse coordinate batch, one entry per requested cell.

Every list holds one entry per cell, in the requested order. Text is stored
once: `text_index` names the cell's entry in `strings`, or `-1` when the cell
has no text, exactly like [`CellOut::string`] reports it.

Members:
- `textIndex` — Entry in [`Self::strings`] per cell, or `-1` for a cell without text.

##### `CellStore` — class

```ts
class CellStore { acknowledgeRevision: (revision: bigint) => void; addPagedSheet: (n_cols: number, row_count: number, chunk_rows: number, byte_budget: number, max_dirty_cells: number) => number; addRows: (sheet: number, at: number, count: number) => void; addSheet: (n_cols: number, row_count: number) => number; admitSourceRange: (sheet: number, r0: number, c0: number, r1: number, c1: number) => boolean; aggregate: (sheet: number, col: number, op: number) => number; beginMutation: () => bigint; beginPageLoad: () => void; captureRange: (sheet: number, r0: number, c0: number, rows: number, cols: number) => RangeSnapshot | undefined; captureReferences: (sheet: number, max_entries: number) => SourceSnapshot | undefined; captureSources: (sheet: number, r0: number, c0: number, rows: number, cols: number) => SourceSnapshot | undefined; captureSourcesForRows: (sheet: number, rows: Uint32Array, cols: Uint32Array) => SourceSnapshot | undefined; cellSnapshots: (sheet: number, rows: Uint32Array, cols: Uint32Array) => CellSnapshot | undefined; cellState: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number) => number; clearCell: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number, style: number) => void; clearRange: (sheet: number, r0: number, c0: number, r1: number, c1: number, contents: boolean, style: boolean) => boolean; colCount: (sheet: number) => number; columnsFullyLoaded: (sheet: number, start_row: number, end_row: number, cols: Uint32Array) => boolean; commitSources: () => void; compactStringStorage: () => void; dataEdge: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number, d_row: number, d_col: number) => number; dataEdgeOrdered: (sheet: number, order: Uint32Array, row: number, col: number, d_row: number, d_col: number) => number; distinctValues: (sheet: number, col: number, limit: number) => DistinctColumn; exportMemoryState: () => Uint8Array; filterRows: (sheet: number, col: number, needle: string) => Uint32Array; filterRowsMulti: (sheet: number, cols: Uint32Array, kinds: Uint8Array, flags: Uint8Array, nums: Float64Array, num_counts: Uint32Array, text_counts: Uint32Array, value_nums: Float64Array, value_texts: string[]) => Uint32Array; formulaMatrixResourceStats: () => Float64Array; formulaReadBands: (sheet: number, start_row: number, end_row: number, cols: Uint32Array, max_cells: number) => Uint32Array; formulaSource: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number) => string | undefined; free: () => void; getCell: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number) => CellOut; getWindow: (sheet: number, row_start: number, row_end: number, cols: Uint32Array) => WindowView; getWindowRows: (sheet: number, rows: Uint32Array, cols: Uint32Array) => WindowView; importRangeMemoryState: (bytes: Uint8Array, sheet: number, row_start: number, col_start: number) => RangeSnapshot; insertCols: (sheet: number, at: number, count: number) => void; isFullyLoaded: (sheet: number) => boolean; isPaged: (sheet: number) => boolean; loadedSpans: (sheet: number, start_row: number, end_row: number, col: number) => Uint32Array; markRangeClean: (sheet: number, start_row: number, end_row: number, start_col: number, end_col: number) => void; memoryStats: () => Float64Array; pagedDirtyCoordinates: (sheet: number) => Float64Array; pagedStats: (sheet: number) => Float64Array; persistedCellData: (sheet: number) => Float64Array; pinReadWindow: (sheet: number, start_row: number, end_row: number, rows: Uint32Array, cols: Uint32Array) => void; pinViewportBands: (sheet: number, bands: Uint32Array) => void; poolStrings: (ids: Uint32Array) => string[]; queryResourceStats: () => Float64Array; rangeFullyLoaded: (sheet: number, r0: number, c0: number, r1: number, c1: number) => boolean; rangeStyleIds: (sheet: number, r0: number, c0: number, r1: number, c1: number) => Uint32Array; recompute: (sheet: number) => void; recomputeVolatile: (serial: number) => boolean; referenceTarget: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number) => Uint32Array | undefined; referencesTargeting: (target_sheet: number, max_entries: number) => Uint32Array | undefined; remapRangeStyles: (sheet: number, r0: number, c0: number, r1: number, c1: number, old_ids: Uint32Array, new_ids: Uint32Array) => boolean; removeCols: (sheet: number, at: number, count: number) => void; removeNamedRange: (name: string, scope: number) => boolean; removeRows: (sheet: number, at: number, count: number) => void; removeSheet: (sheet: number) => boolean; removeTable: (id: string) => boolean; renameSheet: (sheet: number, id: string, name: string) => boolean; resetFormulaMatrixResourceStats: () => void; resetQueryResourceStats: () => void; restoreRange: (sheet: number, r0: number, c0: number, snapshot: RangeSnapshot) => boolean; rowCount: (sheet: number) => number; search: (sheet: number, cols: Uint32Array, query: string, case_insensitive: boolean, whole_cell: boolean) => Uint32Array; setBlockPacked: (sheet: number, start_row: number, start_col: number, rows: number, cols: number, kinds: Uint8Array, numbers: Float64Array, text_buf: Uint8Array, text_offsets: Uint32Array, styles: Uint32Array, formula_offsets: Uint32Array, formula_sources: string[], reference_offsets: Uint32Array, reference_targets: Uint32Array) => number; setBool: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number, value: boolean, style: number) => void; setColumnBlockPacked: (sheet: number, start_row: number, start_col: number, rows: number, cols: number, kinds: Uint8Array, numbers: Float64Array, text_buf: Uint8Array, text_offsets: Uint32Array, styles: Uint32Array, formula_offsets: Uint32Array, formula_sources: string[], reference_offsets: Uint32Array, reference_targets: Uint32Array) => number; setColumnNumbers: (sheet: number, col: number, start_row: number, values: Float64Array, style: number) => void; setColumnStrings: (sheet: number, col: number, start_row: number, values: string[], style: number) => void; setColumnStringsPacked: (sheet: number, col: number, start_row: number, buf: string, utf16_lens: Uint32Array, style: number) => void; setConditionalRules: (sheet: number, kinds: Uint8Array, bounds: Uint32Array, nums: Float64Array, strs: string[], flags: Uint8Array) => void; setFormula: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number, src: string, style: number) => number; setIterativeCalculation: (enabled: boolean, max_iterations: number, max_change: number) => boolean; setNamedRange: (name: string, scope: number, sheet: number, row_start: number, col_start: number, row_end: number, col_end: number) => boolean; setNumber: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number, value: number, style: number) => void; setSavedPivots: (sheet: number, layout: Uint32Array, kinds: Uint8Array, numbers: Float64Array, text: string, text_lengths: Uint32Array) => boolean; setSheetName: (sheet: number, id: string, name: string) => void; setSheetOrder: (order: Uint32Array) => boolean; setSparseBlock: (sheet: number, start_row: number, start_col: number, rows: number, cols: number, offsets: Uint32Array, kinds: Uint8Array, numbers: Float64Array, texts: string[], styles: Uint32Array, formula_offsets: Uint32Array, formula_sources: string[], reference_offsets: Uint32Array, reference_targets: Uint32Array) => number; setSpillBlockers: (sheet: number, bounds: Uint32Array) => boolean; setString: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number, value: string, style: number) => void; setTable: (id: string, name: string, sheet: number, row_start: number, col_start: number, row_end: number, col_end: number, header_row: boolean, totals_row: boolean, column_ids: string[], column_names: string[]) => boolean; sheetSpanFormulaCells: (sheet: number) => Uint32Array; snapshotNumbers: (snapshot: RangeSnapshot) => Float64Array; snapshotTexts: (snapshot: RangeSnapshot) => string[]; sortRowsMulti: (sheet: number, cols: Uint32Array, ascending: Uint8Array, candidates: Uint32Array) => Uint32Array; spillAnchorCol: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number) => number; spillAnchorRow: (sheet: number, row: number, col: number) => number; spillDerivedMask: (sheet: number, row_start: number, row_end: number, cols: Uint32Array) => Uint8Array; stringPoolEpoch: () => number; wasmCommittedBytes: () => number; static importMemoryState: (bytes: Uint8Array) => CellStore }
```

The workbook-wide store: every sheet, one string pool.

Members:
- `addPagedSheet` — Allocate a logical sheet whose cell chunks materialize on page load or edit.
- `addSheet` — Allocate a sheet grid and return its numeric handle.
- `admitSourceRange` — Whether a source rectangle can replace its spill cells without cutting
an installed spill away from its anchor. No owner window crosses WASM.
- `aggregate` — Column aggregate over numeric cells. op: 0 sum, 1 avg, 2 min, 3 max, 4 count.
- `captureRange` — Capture a dense rectangle into an opaque store-local history resource.
- `captureReferences` — Capture only persisted references for one sheet. The explicit entry cap
bounds allocation for host-side structural admission simulation.
- `captureSources` — Capture only persisted formula/reference sources in a rectangle. The
returned opaque object is compact in source cardinality, not cell count.
- `captureSourcesForRows` — Capture persisted formula/reference sources and derived-spill identity
for arbitrary row/column coordinates in one boundary crossing. Offsets
follow the caller's row-major coordinate order.
- `cellSnapshots` — Resolved values of a sparse coordinate list in one batched read.

`rows` and `cols` are absolute coordinates and must have the same length;
otherwise the result carries no cells. Every entry reads exactly like
[`Self::get_cell`], so a batched capture reports the values a per-cell
read would.
- `cellState` — 0 unloaded, 1 loaded-empty, 2 loaded-value, 3 dirty local edit.
- `clearRange` — Clear a rectangle while independently controlling contents and style.
- `commitSources` — Commit staged user or host sources. Admission metadata must be staged
before this barrier; derived values and string roots are complete on return.
Beginning a page load suppresses local dirty tracking until this commit.
- `compactStringStorage` — Reclaim unreachable text and release growth slack at a transaction barrier.
Raw pool IDs must be discarded when `stringPoolEpoch` changes.
- `dataEdge` — Ctrl+Arrow destination: from `(row, col)` stepping by `(d_row, d_col)`
(exactly one of them ±1), return the destination row (vertical moves) or
column (horizontal moves), Google Sheets semantics:

- current and adjacent cell non-empty → end of the contiguous non-empty
 run;
- otherwise → the next non-empty cell in that direction;
- nothing ahead → the sheet edge.
- `exportMemoryState` — Export only live state, not allocator slack or a dependency-index cache.
- `filterRows` — Data-row indices whose column text contains `needle` (case-insensitive).
- `formulaMatrixResourceStats` — Benchmark diagnostic: `[current matrix bytes, peak matrix bytes, allocations]`.
- `formulaReadBands` — Same-sheet calculation prerequisites for `start_row..end_row` × `cols`,
as flat `[row_start, row_end, col_start, col_end)` rectangles.

The walk follows each read into the formula cells it reaches, so for
`H = F - G` and `F = D - E` it reports `D`, `E`, `F`, and `G`.
Spill children follow their anchor; attempted spill destinations are also
prerequisites because admission must establish that source cells are empty.
Reads of other sheets are skipped. `max_cells` bounds the walk: a read larger than
the remaining budget is skipped, so one whole-column range cannot make a
window demand the full column. Rectangles are disjoint and ascend by
column, then by row.
- `getCell` — Single-cell read for interactions/tests — never the render hot path.
- `getWindow` — One bulk read of a rectangular window for the renderer. Returns
contiguous packed cell data (row-major over `rows x cols`) with pool IDs
and window-local formula-error strings, avoiding per-cell boundary reads.
- `getWindowRows` — Bulk read of an explicit row list (sorted/filtered views) — same output
shape as `get_window`, rows taken from `rows` rather than a range.
- `importMemoryState` — Import into a fresh instance; failure never mutates the source store.
- `loadedSpans` — Loaded row runs of one column inside `start_row..end_row`, as flat
`[start, end)` pairs in ascending, disjoint order.

A row belongs to a run only when [`Self::columns_fully_loaded`] would
report it loaded, so a caller can reconcile a whole column with one call
instead of probing the band row by row. Rows outside the sheet and empty
requests produce no pairs.
- `pagedStats` — `[chunks, loaded cells, dirty cells, clean chunk bytes, fully loaded, dirty bytes]`.
- `persistedCellData` — Sparse persisted-cell records. Each record starts with
`[row, col, kind, number, style, string_id, source_kind, source_length]`.
Formula UTF-8 is packed into little-endian u32 words; references append
one `[sheet, row, col]` triple. The allocation scales with serialized
cells and source bytes, never the logical sheet rectangle.
- `pinReadWindow` — Replaces transient read protection without changing viewport pins.
Nonempty `rows` are backing row IDs; otherwise `[start_row, end_row)` is used.
- `pinViewportBands` — Replaces viewport-owned protection independently of transient read pins.
- `queryResourceStats` — `[contains cache constructions, owned distinct strings]`.
- `rangeStyleIds` — Unique style ids present in a rectangle; cost stays inside WASM.
- `recompute` — Recompute formulas affected by cells changed since the last call.

The pass first grows the dirty cell set through formula read-sets to find
all dependent formulas. It then evaluates only those formulas, using a
per-pass memo table to reuse formula results across dependent reads.
- `recomputeVolatile` — Explicit volatile barrier. `serial` is a UTC spreadsheet serial using
the 1899-12-30 epoch; only volatile formulas (TODAY, NOW, RAND,
RANDBETWEEN, OFFSET, INDIRECT) and their dependents recalculate, and TODAY and NOW use
`serial` instead of the clock. Later recalculations read the clock.
- `referencesTargeting` — Return packed `[source_sheet, source_row, source_col, ...]` references
targeting one sheet, bounded before crossing into the host.
- `remapRangeStyles` — Remap styles over a rectangle using parallel old/new id tables.
- `removeSheet` — Tombstone a stable sheet handle and invalidate every formula reference to it.
- `renameSheet` — Rename a live stable sheet handle and rewrite every resolved formula AST reference.
- `restoreRange` — Restore a captured block at a destination of the same dimensions.
- `search` — Cell coordinates whose text matches `query`, as a flat `[row, col, ...]`
list. Scans the requested columns column-major (cache-local), then sorts
row-major so search navigation runs top-to-bottom, left-to-right.
- `setBlockPacked` — Atomically write one row-major mixed literal/formula/reference block
whose text payload arrives packed instead of once per cell.

`text_buf` holds the UTF-8 bytes of every `KIND_STRING` cell of `kinds`
in cell-offset order. `text_offsets` carries their byte boundaries: the
n-th string cell owns `text_offsets[n]..text_offsets[n + 1]`, and the
last entry equals the buffer length, so a block without strings passes an
empty buffer and `&[0]`. Literal strings are interned in cell-offset order;
source-owned text slots are consumed without interning. The compact
status is `0` success, `1` invalid shape/bounds, `2` invalid or duplicate
source metadata, and `3` paged dirty-capacity rejection.
- `setColumnBlockPacked` — Atomically write one column-major mixed literal/formula/reference block
whose text payload arrives packed.

This is [`Self::set_block_packed`] with the flat input arrays in the
store's own column-major order: cell `(row, col)` sits at
`col * rows + row`, so a columnar import can fill them column by column.
Text packing, source metadata and every status code behave exactly as in
[`Self::set_block_packed`].
- `setColumnNumbers` — Bulk-load one column with numbers starting at `start_row`.
- `setColumnStrings` — Bulk-load one column with strings starting at `start_row`.
- `setColumnStringsPacked` — Bulk-load one column of strings from a single concatenated buffer plus
per-row lengths in UTF-16 code units (the JS `string.length` unit).
One boundary decode and one Rust allocation for the whole column,
instead of one per row — the dominant ingest cost for text columns.
- `setConditionalRules` — Replace a sheet's conditional-format rules. Packed columnar encoding,
one entry per rule: `kinds` 0 gt / 1 lt / 2 eqNum / 3 eqStr / 4 eqEmpty /
5 contains / 6 boolean formula; `bounds` = normalized `[r0, c0, r1, c1]`
per rule; `nums` carries the numeric operand; `strs` the text/formula
operand; `flags` bit 0 = match-case for `contains`, bit 1 = stop-if-true.
Formula strings are parsed once here, never once per visible cell.
- `setFormula` — Parse and store a formula at `(row, col)`.

Setters only mark cells dirty; they do not recompute formulas. The host
calls `recompute(sheet)` once at the transaction barrier so a multi-cell
edit performs one dependency-scoped pass instead of one full-sheet pass
per setter. A successful parse returns the pre-write cached scalar; a
parse rejection returns `0.0`, and a rejected write returns `NaN`.

The dependency index is invalidated only when the rewrite changes what
the formula reads or whether it produces an array. A constant-only edit
keeps the cached index, so its next recompute visits just the edited
formula and its dependents instead of every formula in the workbook.
- `setIterativeCalculation` — Turns iterative calculation on or off with Excel's limits: at most
`max_iterations` (1 to 32,767) passes over each circular reference,
stopping once no member changes by more than `max_change` (finite, not
negative). Rejects limits outside those ranges. Recalculates every
formula when the setting changes.
- `setSavedPivots` — Replaces the saved pivot output anchored on `sheet`. This engine
computes no pivots: it shows output a file saved, from the anchor,
at the next recalculation, and never recalculates it.

- `layout`: per output `[anchorRow, anchorCol, rows, cols]`.
- `kinds` and `numbers`: one entry per cell, row-major, output
 after output. Kinds: 0 blank, 1 number, 2 text, 3 boolean
 (`numbers` holds 0 or 1). Text cells take `numbers` 0.
- `text` and `textLengths`: the text cells joined in order, and
 each one's length in UTF-16 code units.

An output that did not change stays installed. Returns `false`,
changing nothing, for a malformed payload or a dead sheet.
- `setSheetOrder` — Set the workbook tab order: every live sheet handle exactly once.
3-D references such as `Sheet1:Sheet3!A1` span the tabs between their
endpoints, so formulas whose span changed are re-placed, their
dependencies patched, and their results recomputed. Rejects an order
that omits, repeats or adds a handle.
- `setSparseBlock` — Write one sparse mixed transaction/page/snapshot block without
allocating by logical rectangle size. Inside `beginPageLoad`, dirty
paged cells are skipped; otherwise the whole sparse write is preflighted.
- `setSpillBlockers` — Replace the host-owned merge/protection collision ranges. Packed as
`[row_start, col_start, row_end, col_end, ...]`; invalid input fails
without weakening the old gate.
- `sheetSpanFormulaCells` — Row and column pairs of the formulas on `sheet` that hold a 3-D
reference. A tab move can rewrite their text, so the host records
their sources before the move to undo it exactly.
- `spillAnchorRow` — Stable spill owner coordinate, or `u32::MAX` when `cell` is not part of
a materialized spill.
- `spillDerivedMask` — Row-major mask aligned with render-window layout; `1` marks a derived
spill cell and deliberately excludes the anchor.
- `stringPoolEpoch` — Raw string IDs are valid only within this epoch, including window IDs.

##### `createEngine` — function

```ts
(source?: Parameters<typeof load>[0]): Promise<EngineInstance>
```

Initialize a fresh engine; a compiled module can be reused without retaining its memory.

##### `DistinctColumn` — class

```ts
class DistinctColumn { free: () => void; takeKinds: () => Uint8Array; takeNumbers: () => Float64Array; takeTexts: () => string[] }
```

Distinct-value scan result for one column: parallel kind/number/text
arrays whose buffers are surrendered once through the `take*` accessors.

Members:
- `takeKinds` — Surrenders the per-value kind tags (number/string/boolean codes); the
column keeps an empty buffer afterwards.
- `takeNumbers` — Surrenders the numeric values aligned with the `takeKinds` tags.
- `takeTexts` — Surrenders the distinct strings aligned with the `takeKinds` tags.

##### `EngineInstance` — type

```ts
export type EngineInstance = Omit<typeof WasmExports, "default" | "CellStore" | "initSync"> & { initSync( ...args: Parameters<typeof WasmExports.initSync> ): Omit<WasmExports.InitOutput, "cellstore_setSavedPivots"> & Partial<Pick<WasmExports.InitOutput, "cellstore_setSavedPivots">>; CellStore: ProviderCellStoreConstructor; getModule(): WebAssembly.Module; getMemory(): WebAssembly.Memory; retire(): void; functionNames?: () => string[]; };
```

Engine objects and caches owned by one independently collectible WASM instance.

##### `InitInput` — type

```ts
export type InitInput = RequestInfo | URL | Response | BufferSource | WebAssembly.Module;
```

Sources accepted by asynchronous initialization: a fetchable URL/request/response, raw module bytes, or a precompiled `WebAssembly.Module`.

readonly windowview_takeStrings: (a: number) => [number, number]; readonly windowview_stringPoolEpoch: (a: number) => number; readonly windowview_takePacked: (a: number) => [number, number]; readonly __wbindgen_malloc: (a: number, b: number) => number; readonly __wbindgen_realloc: (a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number) => number; readonly __wbindgen_externrefs: WebAssembly.Table; readonly __wbindgen_free: (a: number, b: number, c: number) => void; readonly __externref_drop_slice: (a: number, b: number) => void; readonly __externref_table_alloc: () => number; readonly __wbindgen_start: () => void; }

Result of module initialization: the instantiated exports plus the shared linear memory.

##### `initSync` — function

```ts
(module: { module: SyncInitInput; } | SyncInitInput): InitOutput
```

Instantiates the given `module`, which can either be bytes or
a precompiled `WebAssembly.Module`.

##### `isLoaded` — function

```ts
(): boolean
```

Whether the WASM module has finished initializing.

##### `load` — function

```ts
(source?: BufferSource | URL | string | Request | WebAssembly.Module): Promise<void>
```

Initialize the WASM module. Idempotent and re-entrant: concurrent
same-source callers share one in-flight init; a concurrent different-source
call rejects; a different-source call after success warns and no-ops; a
rejected init is retryable. When `source` is omitted the loader picks the
right strategy for the runtime.
@example
```ts
import { initSheetwrite } from "@sheetwrite/core";

await initSheetwrite();
```
@see
/docs/start/installation/

##### `RangeSnapshot` — class

```ts
class RangeSnapshot { byteLength: () => number; exportMemoryState: (sheet: number) => Uint8Array; formulaOffsets: () => Uint32Array; formulaSources: () => string[]; free: () => void; kinds: () => Uint8Array; referenceOffsets: () => Uint32Array; referenceTargets: () => Uint32Array; styleIds: () => Uint32Array }
```

Opaque, store-local history payload for one dense rectangular cell block.

The host may retain this object in undo history, but it is deliberately not
part of the serialized document protocol. A deduplicated local dictionary
owns captured text independently of the store's pool epoch.

Members:
- `exportMemoryState` — Transfer packed scalars and the local dictionary, never JS cell patches.

##### `SourceSnapshot` — class

```ts
class SourceSnapshot { formulaOffsets: () => Uint32Array; formulaSources: () => string[]; free: () => void; referenceOffsets: () => Uint32Array; referenceTargets: () => Uint32Array; spillDerived: () => Uint8Array }
```

Compact serializable projection of persisted derived-cell sources and spill
identity in one range. Offsets are row-major and sorted; reference targets
are packed `[sheet_handle, row, col]` triples.

##### `SyncInitInput` — type

```ts
export type SyncInitInput = BufferSource | WebAssembly.Module;
```

Sources accepted by synchronous initialization: raw module bytes or a precompiled `WebAssembly.Module`.

##### `WindowView` — class

```ts
class WindowView { free: () => void; nCols: number; nRows: number; stringPoolEpoch: () => number; takePacked: () => Uint8Array; takeStrings: () => string[] }
```

A bulk window of resolved cells, row-major over `n_rows x n_cols`.

Members:
- `takePacked` — Consume the complete fixed-width window payload. The returned
`Uint8Array` is copied by wasm-bindgen into JS-owned memory.
- `takeStrings` — Consume formula-error sentinel strings referenced by the packed data.

#### `@sheetwrite/wasm/wasm` — asset

Declaration target: `./pkg/sheetwrite_wasm_bg.wasm`
Page: https://www.sheetwrite.dev/docs/api/wasm-wasm/

### `@sheetwrite/xlsx`

#### `@sheetwrite/xlsx` — supported

Declaration target: `./dist/index.d.ts`
Source entry: `src/index.ts`
Page: https://www.sheetwrite.dev/docs/api/xlsx/

##### `buildXlsxModel` — function

```ts
(workbook: Workbook, store: Store, options?: XlsxWorkbookOptions): XlsxModel | null
```

Build the active-sheet table model used by the bounded OOXML writer.

##### `registerXlsxBackends` — function

```ts
(): void
```

Register all concrete XLSX backends with the backend-neutral core contracts.
@example
```ts
import { registerXlsxBackends } from "@sheetwrite/xlsx";
import { fromXlsxWorkbook } from "@sheetwrite/core";

registerXlsxBackends();
async function open(file: File) {
 return fromXlsxWorkbook(await file.arrayBuffer());
}
```
@see
/docs/import-export/xlsx-export/

##### `sheetwriteTableExportBackend` — variable

```ts
XlsxTableExportBackend
```

Default bounded first-sheet table export backend.

##### `sheetwriteTableImportBackend` — variable

```ts
XlsxTableImportBackend
```

Default bounded first-sheet table import backend.

##### `sheetwriteWorkbookBackend` — variable

```ts
XlsxWorkbookBackend
```

Deterministic optional OOXML workbook backend implemented by Sheetwrite.

##### `XlsxModel` — interface

```ts
export interface XlsxModel { sheetName: string; columnWidths: number[]; rowHeights: (number | undefined)[]; rows: (XlsxModelCell | null)[][]; }
```

Implementation-neutral first-sheet table export model.

##### `XlsxModelCell` — interface

```ts
export interface XlsxModelCell { value: CellScalar; style?: CellStyle; numberFormat?: string; columnSpan?: number; rowSpan?: number; }
```

Implementation-neutral cell in the first-sheet table export model.
